items.description: Mohsen Rezaee has warned that if the US continues bombing Iran, Tehran will escalate its response into full-scale war.

items.title: Why Russia's hybrid warfare is forcing France to raise its voice
items.description: Between acts of sabotage and drone flyovers, the General Directorate of Internal Security (DGSI) attributed a large-scale cyberespionage campaign to Russian domestic intelligence. In response, the chargé d'affaires at the Russian embassy in Paris was summoned by the foreign minister on Friday, July 17.

items.title: Gaza officials say several killed in Israeli strike
items.description: Palestinian health and civil defense officials said at least eight people were killed while attending a funeral. Israel's military said it had struck a "terrorist cell" from the Islamic Jihad militant group.

items.title: Many Ukrainian soldiers outraged over removal of defence minister, troops tell BBC
items.description: Protests erupted in Ukraine on Thursday after Mykhailo Fedorov's removal - and now soldiers are also criticising the move.

items.title: US Senate Leadership Throws Weight Behind Renewed Russia Sanctions Push
items.description: Senate Republican leadership has thrown its weight behind a renewed bipartisan push to impose sweeping new sanctions on Russia that supporters say marks the strongest congressional effort yet to increase economic pressure on Moscow over its war against Ukraine.

items.title: Boris Nadezhdin is a rare Russian politician speaking out against the Ukraine war
items.description: Boris Nadezhdin wants to run for Russia's parliament on a platform that gives voice to the Russians against the war in Ukraine. That's why, he says, the Kremlin is doing everything to stop him.

items.title: Russia Fires 6,001 Drones, 170 Bombs as Ukraine Repels 235 Clashes
items.description: The Armed Forces of Ukraine repelled 235 clashes across the front line on Wednesday, July 15, with the heaviest fighting near Pokrovsk and Kostiantynivka. Russian forces used 170 guided bombs and 6,001 kamikaze drones during the assault.
